title: Density readings graph for Montana film, images 1 and 2
description: Hand-plotted graph titled "DENSITY READINGS" showing film density for two images (solid and dashed lines) across frames 0 to about 130, with a gap marked "NO IMAGE" in the early frames. A note reads "NOTE — Montana film. Lowest reading indicates brightest image", with a legend for Image 1 and 2 and an enclosure label. Stamped CONFIDENTIAL SECURITY INFORMATION.
